import ethsc.cli as cli
from ethsc.cli import main
from ethsc.rpc import RpcError
from ethsc.store import Store
from tests.helpers import FakeRpc, load_hex
BELLE = "0x34c6211621f2763c60eb007dc2ae91090a2d22f6"
COPIES = [("0x1807090dd15a6f58e00fd769e32ebf20ee610385", "code_belle_copy_1807090d.hex"),
          ("0x2141be5f2afa674c94167ab167a478a56cb539f5", "code_belle_copy_2141be5f.hex"),
          ("0x46cadea509dc3d3c96a11fb61ab8b222f5238f0a", "code_belle_copy_46cadea5.hex"),
          ("0x6411bed82614b91ef655d82486e0bd3a13d2eb8c", "code_belle_copy_6411bed8.hex")]
EOA = "0x023697eda1dfbe331c2cf791ef2f6089e73e3230"
BELLE_TEXT = "0x" + load_hex("code_belle.hex").hex()
def newdb():
    return os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="p12-probe-"), "e.sqlite")
def copies_db(with_belle=False, seeded=False):
    p = newdb(); s = Store(p)
    for a, f in COPIES:
        s.put_address(a, s.put_code(load_hex(f)), 26077729)
    if with_belle:
        s.put_address(BELLE, s.put_code(load_hex("code_belle.hex")), 26077729)
        if seeded:
            s.add_seed(BELLE, "BELLE honeypot")
    s.close()
    return p
def cli_run(argv, rpc=None):
    out, err = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()
    with redirect_stdout(out), redirect_stderr(err):
        rc = main(argv, rpc=rpc)
    return rc, out.getvalue(), err.getvalue()
def rows(p):
    c = sqlite3.connect(p)
    try:
        return tuple(c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM %s" % t).fetchone()[0] for t in ("addresses", "codes", "seeds"))
    finally:
        c.close()
def block_of(p, a):
    c = sqlite3.connect(p)
    try:
        r = c.execute("SELECT block FROM addresses WHERE address = ?", (a,)).fetchone()
        return r and r[0]
    finally:
        c.close()
def alerts(label):
    return "".join("ALERT\t%s\t%s\t%s\t0.8667\n" % (a, BELLE, label) for a, f in COPIES)
def today():
    return datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

def store_remove():
    p = copies_db(True, True); s = Store(p)
    try:
        r1 = s.remove_seed(BELLE.upper().replace("0X", "0x")); r2 = s.remove_seed(BELLE)
        chk("Manage Watchlist 3: remove_seed twice", (r1, r2), (True, False))
        chk("Manage Watchlist 3: after remove (seeds, has_address, code kept)", (s.seeds(), s.has_address(BELLE), s.code_of(BELLE) == load_hex("code_belle.hex")), ([], True, True))
        s.add_seed(BELLE, "BELLE again")
        chk("Manage Watchlist 3: re-add", [x["label"] for x in s.seeds()], ["BELLE again"])
    finally:
        s.close()
    p = newdb(); s = Store(p)
    try:
        chk("Manage Watchlist 4: fresh db", s.remove_seed(BELLE), False)
        s.put_address(BELLE, s.put_code(load_hex("code_belle.hex")), 1)
        chk("Manage Watchlist 4: stored, not seeded", s.remove_seed(BELLE), False)
    finally:
        s.close()
    chk("Manage Watchlist 4: rows unchanged", rows(p), (1, 1, 0))
def fetch_new():
    p = copies_db()
    fake = FakeRpc(codes={BELLE: BELLE_TEXT}, head="0x18dea21")
    rc, out, err = cli_run(["--db", p, "seed", "add", "--fetch", BELLE.upper().replace("0X", "0x"), "--label", "BELLE honeypot"], fake)
    chk("Command Line 28: exit, stderr", (rc, err), (0, ""))
    chk("Command Line 28: stdout", out, alerts("BELLE honeypot"))
    chk("Command Line 28: rpc calls", fake.calls, [("eth_blockNumber", []), ("eth_getCode", [BELLE, "latest"])])
    s = Store(p)
    try:
        chk("Command Line 28: stored code, seeds, ledger", (s.code_of(BELLE) == load_hex("code_belle.hex"), [x["address"] for x in s.seeds()], s.spent(today())), (True, [BELLE], 0))
    finally:
        s.close()

    fake2 = FakeRpc(fail=AssertionError("no rpc"))

    chk("Command Line 29: stored address again (rc, stdout, calls)", (rc, out, fake2.calls), (0, alerts("BELLE again"), []))
def fetch_eoa():
    p = newdb()
    fake = FakeRpc(codes={EOA: "0x"}, head="0x18dea21")
    argv = ["--db", p, "seed", "add", "--fetch", EOA, "--label", "L"]
    rc, out, err = cli_run(argv, fake)

    fake2 = FakeRpc(fail=AssertionError("no rpc"))
    rc, out, err = cli_run(argv, fake2)
    chk("Command Line 30: second run (rc, stdout, calls)", (rc, out, fake2.calls), (2, "", []))
def fetch_errors():
    p = newdb()
    fake = FakeRpc(fail=RpcError(-32000, "header not found"))
    rc, out, err = cli_run(["--db", p, "seed", "add", "--fetch", BELLE, "--label", "L"], fake)
    chk("Command Line 31: RpcError (rc, stdout, stderr, calls)", (rc, out, err, [m for m, _ in fake.calls]), (1, "", "header not found\n", ["eth_blockNumber"]))
    chk("Command Line 31: nothing stored", rows(p), (0, 0, 0))

        p = newdb()
        rc, out, err = cli_run(["--db", p, "seed", "add", "--fetch", BELLE, "--label", "L"], FakeRpc(codes={BELLE: answer}, head="0x18dea21"))
        chk("Command Line 32: answer %r (rc, stdout, stderr)" % (answer,), (rc, out, err), (1, "", "eth_getCode returned no code: %s\n" % BELLE))
        chk("Command Line 32: answer %r nothing stored" % (answer,), rows(p), (0, 0, 0))
def fetch_client():
    made = []
    def rec(*a, **k):
        made.append((a, k))
        return FakeRpc(codes={BELLE: BELLE_TEXT}, head="0x18dea21")
    def no_infura(*a, **k):
        raise AssertionError("infura_url called")
    p = newdb(); p2 = newdb()
    with mock.patch.object(cli, "RpcClient", rec), mock.patch.object(cli, "infura_url", no_infura):
        r1 = cli_run(["--db", p, "seed", "add", "--fetch", BELLE, "--label", "BELLE honeypot"])[0]
        r2 = cli_run(["--db", p, "seed", "add", "--fetch", BELLE, "--label", "x"])[0]
        r3 = cli_run(["--db", p2, "seed", "add", BELLE, "--label", "x"])[0]
    chk("Command Line 33: exit codes", (r1, r2, r3), (0, 0, 2))
    chk("Command Line 33: RpcClient constructions", len(made), 1)
    if made:
        a, k = made[0]
        url = a[0] if a else k.get("url")
        chk("Command Line 33: client (url, prices, max_retries)", (url, k.get("prices"), k.get("max_retries")), ("https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com", {}, 5))
def remove():
    p = copies_db(True, True)
    fake = FakeRpc(fail=AssertionError("no rpc"))
    up = BELLE.upper().replace("0X", "0x")
    rc, out, err = cli_run(["--db", p, "seed", "remove", up], fake)
    chk("Command Line 34: remove (rc, stdout, stderr)", (rc, out, err), (0, "", ""))
    chk("Command Line 34: recheck after remove", cli_run(["--db", p, "recheck"], fake)[:2], (0, ""))
    rc, out, err = cli_run(["--db", p, "seed", "remove", up], fake)
    chk("Command Line 34: second remove", (rc, out, err), (2, "", "not a seed: %s\n" % up))
    chk("Command Line 34: rows, calls", (rows(p), fake.calls), ((5, 5, 0), []))
    rc, out, err = cli_run(["--db", p, "seed", "add", BELLE, "--label", "BELLE honeypot"])
    chk("Command Line 34: re-add without --fetch", (rc, out), (0, alerts("BELLE honeypot")))
def bad_address():
    p = newdb()
    fake = FakeRpc(fail=AssertionError("no rpc"))
    a = cli_run(["--db", p, "seed", "remove", "0x12"])
    b = cli_run(["--db", p, "seed", "add", "--fetch", "0x12", "--label", "L"], fake)
    chk("Command Line 35: (rc, stdout, stderr lines) remove, add", ((a[0], a[1], a[2].count("\n")), (b[0], b[1], b[2].count("\n")), fake.calls), ((2, "", 1), (2, "", 1), []))
for n, f in (("store remove_seed", store_remove), ("fetch new", fetch_new), ("fetch eoa", fetch_eoa),
             ("fetch errors", fetch_errors), ("fetch client", fetch_client), ("remove", remove), ("bad address", bad_address)):
    run(n, f)
print("\n".join(bad) if bad else "probe OK: cli-p12")
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
